note: Two layers. 'studies': one PREMIERE-format line per cited PMID (arms or design, main result, limitation), curated from the team's own evidence-summary PPT text (V15 libraries) and the site's verified text; 'quotes' are the exact source passages that contain every number. 'options': per treatment option (key = page slug + hash of the option's visible statement), the numerical results that the option's own text reports and attributes to a named cited study, restated in LRT style. Only these option rows display numbers under an option; a shared citation alone never brings a number into an option. 'reference_groups' and 'reference_links': explicit, reviewed presentation of source-study evidence from the HCC treatment references (liver-directed reference, systemic matrix, HCC roadmap text and critique records) for the linked modality or regimen, with the studied population, treatment arms and endpoint/horizon; every number is guarded against that study's verified site text or an exact quoted passage. Not an eligibility rule and not a regrading.
